action: choose once per whole window among 27 identical (CPU,GPU,DLA) triplets for each of A/C
reset: At each real scene transition reset thermal state only to common inlet; attach complete tail to last scene. No queue reset.
selection: filter full completion, all deadlines and certified continuous peak within the evaluated segment(s); rank by full window joules. unresolvable peak certificate excluded. ties within 1e-9 J of global minimum: A before C, CPU then GPU then DLA levels L<M<H.
evidence: only synthetic causal ablation conditional on frozen model; fixed timing independent of temperature, thermal protection is hard feasibility not automatic throttling
preregistered_traces: 10s/25 FPS/both ambients/base/leakage on, HHH both deployments/modes plus all selected physical replays in summary
parameter_change: No outcome-driven changes. Technical failures that leave input and numerical policy identical may be repaired and logged.
